findings.issue: שֶׂה is one singular flock-animal. "res del rebaño" adds an untokened flock phrase and a generic livestock head.
לְחַטָּאת stands parallel to לְעֹלָה as the offering noun; "pecado" can be read as bare sin rather than that offering.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens in number, person, stem, and participants.
